conviction_note: Scaled number (2*0.40-1)*6.5 = -1.3 sits close to the findings' sum of -1.5. Both rest mainly on one company-level fact: on the 12 confirmed print dates since 2023-10 this stock fell after 11, with a median of about -7.5% (kabuyoho dates, Yahoo closes). Against that, the bad news (a loss guide and no dividend) has been public since 2026-07-13, the theme crowd has already cut the price 36% from its 2026-08-31 peak, and nothing new from the company has been found since 2026-08-27. So the lean is moderate and the scale is large.

findings.finding: On the 12 confirmed results dates from 2023-10-10 to 2026-07-13, the next-session reaction was negative 11 times: -25.1, -4.7, -12.6, -1.3, -2.9, -4.1, -7.1, +8.7, -11.9, -7.9, -8.1 and -16.6%. The median is about -7.5% and the median absolute move about 7.5%, against the baseline's 4.51% proxy, which rests on mis-estimated dates.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This finding IS the reaction history. The worst reactions came at prints carrying a cut or a stretched held plan: 2026-07-13 cut to a loss plus dividend cut, -16.6%; 2025-10-09 held a stretched plan, -11.9%. The only positive was 2025-07-10, an upward revision, +8.7%.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-08 (revision-history table listing each print date); prices from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3907.T?range=3y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: The sealed scale (4.51%) and history (median 2.6%) were built on cadence-estimated dates that miss most real print days, so the baseline does not show the name's print-day reaction function. The priced lean is +0.31, mildly positive. If the market held this pattern, the lean would read negative. Partly priced: the stock already fell 14.9% over 5 sessions into the print, which is why this is sized well under the history's median.
findings.independence: Same price series as the baseline tape. The print dates come from a different source (IFIS/kabuyoho revision table), cross-checked against kabutan's 2026-07-13 16:00 tanshin stamp (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3907&page=4).

findings.finding: The Q3 cumulative result has little room against the FY plan. H1 OP was -185m against a FY plan of -200m, so Q3+Q4 must total -15m. Q3 last year (Jun-Aug) made only +5m OP, and H1 SG&A ran +11.4% YoY on physical-AI investment. Any Q3 loss therefore puts the 9-month figure beyond the full-year plan, and the plan then rests on Q4 again. This company held a stretched plan at Q3 in FY2025 (9-month OP 126m vs FY 185m), fell 11.9%, and then missed (actual 147m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-09, stretched plan held at Q3: -11.9%. 2024-10-10, plan cut at Q3 (OP 254m to 148m): -2.9%. 2026-07-13, plan cut to a loss: -16.6%. 2025-07-10, plan raised: +8.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The 進捗率 arithmetic is computable from the last 短信, and the loss plus no dividend have been public since 07-13 (LESSONS rule 1). What is not in the price is whether the release ADDS a second cut. On the record the company cut at Q3 once in three years (FY2024) and held a stretched plan once (FY2025). The tanshin also states that the 3DCG project's revenue is booked in one lump in H2, so Q3 sales could print up YoY, which is the offsetting case. Hence the small size and the wide range.
findings.independence: The revision record comes from the kabuyoho table (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=3907), a different source from the tanshin. It shares the 2025-10-09 reaction with finding 1, so the two are not fully independent.

findings.finding: Since the Q2 print the company has announced a physical-AI collaboration with ジーデップ・アドバンス (2026-08-25, stock limit-up) and a new 官公庁事業推進室 for defence and public-sector work (announced 2026-08-27, effective 2026-09-01, limit-up 08-28). The Q3 tanshin's qualitative section is the first results document that can describe pipeline or orders in these lines, which is the stock's theme.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Theme announcements without numbers moved it +16.8% (2026-08-26) and +23.4% (2026-08-28). No results print has yet carried physical-AI or defence revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: The theme was priced and then un-priced: the stock fell from 2,635 to 1,685 as no follow-up arrived after 08-27 (no TDnet disclosure from 3907 in the 31 days to 10-08, checked page by page). A concrete order or pipeline line in the release would be new; a silent tanshin would not. This is an upside tail, so it is sized small with a wide upper range.

outside_window.finding: The full-year outcome against the -200m OP plan. In FY2025 a plan held at Q3 was missed at the year-end print (147m vs 185m), and the FY11/2026 result is due about mid-January 2027.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible, not filed in advance. The company cut at Q3 once in three years (FY2024), held a stretched plan once (FY2025), and held through FY2023. A hold is the base case. Returns: none expected (dividend already 0, cash falling). New-year guide: no, this is a Q3 print. Quarter vs own 進捗率: last year's Q3 cumulative was 68.6% of the ordinary plan. This year the plan is a loss, so progress cannot be read as a ratio; any Q3 loss pushes the 9-month figure past the FY -198m ordinary plan.

baseline_tension: The priced lean is +0.31 (squeeze and run-up components offset the short-building one) and the 20-day run-up is -18.8%, so the free control leans up while my findings lean down. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held plan, Q3 sales up YoY on the lump 3DCG revenue, a concrete physical-AI or defence order line, and 悪材料出尽くし after a 36% drawdown from the peak. I looked for a buyback or dividend and found neither possible nor signalled. That positive case is why p_up is 40 and not 30.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): finding 2 cut from -1.0 to -0.5, because the stretched-plan arithmetic is public since 07-13 and only a second cut would add to it.

Rule 1/2 together: finding 1 cut from -2.0 to -1.5 and p_up moved 38 to 40, because the loss guide and no dividend are known and a 36% drawdown makes 出尽くし plausible; the strongest positive case is written into baseline_tension.
